## About the Story: Jasmine and the Farm Life

The tale centers around Jasmine, who has a busy life on the farm. Caring for two orphaned baby birds is challenging enough, but she must also look after a newly born lamb that is left without a mother and requires all of her attention. As they navigate their days, they face unseen dangers within the flock of sheep. This heartwarming journey captures the themes of care, resilience, and community, making it an engaging read for young hearts.
